text_block_list.text: <chrname> competed for the pinnacle against the formidable rivals—and the Three Goddesses.
Though she couldn't seize the top, her magnificent run showed how much she had grown—she was practically unrecognizable from when we first met.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
Heh, I thought she'd be down, but it seems
she feels the exact same way we do.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
You have done well to reach this stage and see it through.
Your running has fully satisfied our expectations.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
The growth of the Umamusume is our wish—
and you have shown that to us clearly.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
You're not done running yet, right?
Next time, show me what it looks like when you reach the top!
And so, the fierce clash of the Grand Masters came to an end, leaving a lasting impression on all who witnessed it.

And today, as always, the Umamusume
continue to devote themselves to their daily training.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Both Bitter Glace and Little Cocon seem to feel more fulfilled and motivated than ever before.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Truth be told, seeing the Umamusume in such great shape
has made my days very fulfilling as well.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm working hard every day
to become a one-of-a-kind Trainer for Meek as well!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Each and every day like this will eventually become the hoofprints—the history—walked by an Umamusume and her Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Is history being engraved nicely
for you, Trainer <username>?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
However, our race is not over yet.
Because they are still running even now.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
We need to brace ourselves
so we don't get left behind either!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: ...Right, and one more thing.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: I've started noticing other girls getting inspired by how those two run.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: "Just as it was with us, the running of Umamusume is something passed on from one to the next, isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Will the way Bitter Glasse and I run
eventually inspire other girls too, I wonder...?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Who knows, you might end up
taking charge of a girl just like that.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: That sounds so dramatic somehow!
(Knock knock knock!)

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Trainer Kashimoto, it's time for training!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Competition for the simulator is fierce, so you'd better hurry over.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
...We might not have time to take it easy.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Looks like you're fully prepared today too.
Understood. Let us be off.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Trainer <username>!
Let's get going too!
Today once again, the Umamusume run, their hearts swelling with the desire to race—
Spun from the history that is knowledge, they continued to etch a brand-new history today.
